description: Returns all WSF ferry terminals with their numeric IDs, names, abbreviations, and coordinates. Call this first to resolve human-readable terminal names (e.g. "Bainbridge Island", "Seattle", "Kingston") to the numeric terminal IDs required by the schedule and space tools. The terminal list is small (20 terminals) and rarely changes.
name: wsdot_get_ferry_terminals

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `api_unavailable`: WSF Ferry API is unreachable or returns a non-2xx response after retries. `invalid_access_code`: WSF rejected the request because WSDOT_ACCESS_CODE is missing, invalid, or not registered. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Optional notice when no terminal data is available. Absent on normal results.

items.description: A WSF ferry terminal with its ID and location.

terminalId.description: Numeric terminal ID used in schedule and space API calls. Absent when upstream omits it.

terminalName.description: Full terminal name (e.g. "Bainbridge Island"). Absent when upstream omits it.

title: Get Ferry Terminals
